newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 4.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 4.

text.p: -- WHX Corp unit Wheeling-Pittsburgh Corp and the United Steelworkers of America said they had reached tentative agreement on a new five-year contract, settling a 10-month strike. WHX Corp stock closed at 9-7/8 on Friday.

-- Motorola Inc and International Business Machines Corp said they will introduce three PowerPC microprocessors, including two new chips and a high-speed upgrade to an existing model. Motorola closed at 80-3/4 while IBM finished at 104-15/16.

-- J.C. Penney Co Inc Chief Financial Officer Donald McKay said he was comfortable with the range of analysts' estimates for the company's second quarter earnings: $0.34 to $0.42 per share. Penney closed at 57-5/8.

-- Time Warner Inc, looking to cut its debt and shed some nonstrategic operations, has offered to sell cable systems valued at about $350 million, the Wall Street Journal reported. Time Warner closed at 54-1/16.
